نستكين (form X)
# نَسْتَكِينُ (nastakīnu) /nas.ta.kiː.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكَانَ (istakāna)
# نَسْتَكِينَ (nastakīna) /nas.ta.kiː.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَكَانَ (istakāna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
